$comment: Package H: every reference photo, settled by content. 'kind': stock (BMW only, no theme connected), stock+theme (BMW's own drawing while a theme is connected: the mode label and gear letter move into the bottom row and, usually, a black box sits on the tacho hub), grid (our calibration grid over stock+theme), ours (our theme on the car), bench (a render). 'same_exposure_as': the two files are one frame (tools/strip/H/same_frame.py: identity affine, NCC >= 0.998, median |grey diff| 1-2 levels, i.e. one is a re-encode/downscale of the other; the capture metadata agree to the second). Measurements on such a pair are ONE observation. Capture times are given only as dates and as offsets between photos. No photo text is recorded here.
axis_note: The bottom row the 6WB see-through layouts live with is BMW's row WITH a theme connected. Of the stock-visible photos only 10=60, 14 and 17 show that arrangement; 61-68 (except 60) show the no-theme arrangement, whose mode label and gear sit in the tacho centre, not in the row.
